designDefect.discovery: Code review of missing final records followed by an executed native reproduction; not discovered by the generated campaign.
designDefect.failure: After an envelope had been returned, deleting its final ledger row left a legal unfinished prefix. The initial owner reopened and returned different wire bytes for the same network position.
designDefect.initialEvidence: pre-repair-missing-tail.log: expected refusal fails after the test verified same position and different bytes. The initial 19-case passing campaign was insufficient and is superseded.
designDefect.repair: Private content counter v2 carries an authenticated hash-chain witness. Every ledger event and next signed witness commit in one native transaction. Census verifies completeness before startup, compaction or envelope exposure. V7 activation installs the witness before admission; interrupted activation resumes.
designDefect.regression: Missing final row and entire ledger refuse with current metadata retained. Before/after native commits verify atomicity and interrupted activation.
designDefect.control: The no-witness actual-module mutation reproduces remint; missing-tail-control.json retains synthetic before/after wire and external invocation counts.
designDefect.limits: Coordinated restoration of old authenticated metadata and its matching ledger remains outside local rollback detection.

harnessRetry: The shared regression wrapper reused the previous compaction output directory. The harness correctly refused overwrite; the final direct Node compaction run uses content-trim-witness. Source capture passed and was not repeated.

otherControls.earlyReturn: Actual owner returns encrypted bytes before persistence; no envelope exists on cold restart.
otherControls.reuseAttempt: Actual owner reuses an abandoned reservation; two observed network encryption calls with only one durable grant.
otherControls.budget: Reduced limit permits two native calls and refuses the prohibited third before AES.
otherControls.oldReader: Previous signed promotion parser rejects v7.

implementationReview: Asynchronous census verification now drains inside the lifecycle task; prepared keys initialize before carrier initialization invokes that validator. Internal composition alone receives spool counter and task authority.

ledger.includes: Real signed/encrypted wire, exact sources/actors, removed grants, missing suffix/all ledger, changed witness, independent invocation accounting and reservation preservation.

native.includes: Real editing with allocation/attempt/envelope before/after commits, renderer death, compaction, retained exact wire and external crypto observations.

scope: Disposable Chromium and synthetic fixtures; strict native transaction completion and renderer death, not physical power loss, large-backlog performance or whole-protocol proof. No personal browser, real Account or server operations. Relay and response/refusal authority remain absent.
